legend: Within a well-known video game, our hero faces "The Beast", the final boss of the game, and wants to know if he is capable of defeating her or not.

The hero has P$$$P$$$ power points and has N$$$N$$$ different weapons at his disposal. Each weapon is characterized by three integers A$$$A$$$, B$$$B$$$, and C$$$C$$$. When attacking with a weapon, if the hero currently has P$$$P$$$ power points, he will have ⌊P−BA⌋$$$\displaystyle{\left \lfloor \frac{P-B}{A}\right \rfloor}$$$ power points after the attack, inflicting damage to The Beast such that she loses C$$$C$$$ health points. After hitting The Beast, the weapons break. For this reason, each weapon can be used at most once.
The hero wins the confrontation if he manages to defeat The Beast. To achieve this, his power points must be non-negative, and The Beast's health points must be zero or negative.
What is the maximum amount of health points V$$$V$$$ that The Beast can initially have for the hero to be able to defeat her?

Note: ⌊x⌋$$$\lfloor x \rfloor$$$ is the largest integer such that ⌊x⌋≤x$$$\lfloor x \rfloor \leq x$$$. For example, ⌊2.5⌋=2,⌊π⌋=3,⌊−2.75⌋=−3$$$\lfloor 2.5 \rfloor=2, \lfloor \pi \rfloor=3, \lfloor -2.75 \rfloor=-3$$$.
input: A line with two integers N$$$N$$$ and P$$$P$$$ (1≤N≤200,1≤P≤105)$$$(1 \leq N \leq 200, 1 \leq P \leq 10^5)$$$, the number of weapons and the initial amount of power points of the hero.
Then N$$$N$$$ lines that describe the weapons with three integers A$$$A$$$, B$$$B$$$, and C$$$C$$$ (1≤A,B,C≤105)$$$(1 \leq A, B, C \leq 10^5)$$$.
output: A line with an integer V$$$V$$$, the maximum amount of health points that The Beast can have.
note: In the first example, if The Beast has 11$$$11$$$ health points, the hero can use the second weapon, reducing his power points from 66$$$66$$$ to ⌊66−88⌋=7$$$\lfloor \frac{66-8}{8}\rfloor=7$$$ and The Beast's health points to 2$$$2$$$. Then, he can use the third weapon, reducing his power points from 7$$$7$$$ to ⌊7−52⌋=1$$$\lfloor \frac{7-5}{2}\rfloor=1$$$ and The Beast's health points to 0$$$0$$$. If The Beast starts with 12$$$12$$$ health points or more, then it is impossible to defeat her.

In the second example, if The Beast has 10$$$10$$$ health points, the hero can first use the second weapon and then the first, reducing his power points to 0$$$0$$$ and The Beast's health points to 0$$$0$$$.
In the third example, the only way for the hero to win is if The Beast has 0$$$0$$$ health points initially.

legend.ai: 在一款知名电子游戏中，我们的英雄面对游戏的最终 Boss“野兽”，他想知道自己是否有能力击败她。

英雄拥有 P$$$P$$$ 点力量，并有 N$$$N$$$ 种不同的武器可供使用。每种武器由三个整数 A$$$A$$$、B$$$B$$$ 和 C$$$C$$$ 描述。使用武器攻击时，若英雄当前有 P$$$P$$$ 点力量，那么攻击后他将拥有 ⌊P−BA⌋$$$\displaystyle{\left \lfloor \frac{P-B}{A}\right \rfloor}$$$ 点力量，同时对野兽造成伤害，使她损失 C$$$C$$$ 点生命值。击中野兽后，武器会损坏。因此，每种武器最多只能使用一次。
如果英雄成功击败野兽，他就赢得了这场战斗。为此，他的力量点数必须非负，并且野兽的生命值必须小于或等于零。
为了让英雄能够击败野兽，野兽初始生命值 V$$$V$$$ 的最大值是多少？
注意：⌊x⌋$$$\lfloor x \rfloor$$$ 表示满足 ⌊x⌋≤x$$$\lfloor x \rfloor \leq x$$$ 的最大整数。例如，⌊2.5⌋=2，⌊π⌋=3，⌊−2.75⌋=−3$$$\lfloor 2.5 \rfloor=2, \lfloor \pi \rfloor=3, \lfloor -2.75 \rfloor=-3$$$。

input.ai: 一行包含两个整数 N$$$N$$$ 和 P$$$P$$$(1≤N≤200,1≤P≤105)$$$(1 \leq N \leq 200, 1 \leq P \leq 10^5)$$$，分别表示武器数量和英雄初始的力量点数。
接下来是 N$$$N$$$ 行，每行包含三个整数 A$$$A$$$、B$$$B$$$ 和 C$$$C$$$，用于描述武器(1≤A,B,C≤105)$$$(1 \leq A, B, C \leq 10^5)$$$。

output.ai: 一行包含一个整数 V$$$V$$$，表示 The Beast 所能拥有的最大生命值。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，如果 The Beast 拥有 11$$$11$$$ 点生命值，英雄可以使用第二把武器，将自己的力量值从 66$$$66$$$ 降低到 ⌊66−88⌋=7$$$\lfloor \frac{66-8}{8}\rfloor=7$$$，并将 The Beast 的生命值降低到 2$$$2$$$。随后，他可以使用第三把武器，将自己的力量值从 7$$$7$$$ 降低到 ⌊7−52⌋=1$$$\lfloor \frac{7-5}{2}\rfloor=1$$$，并将 The Beast 的生命值降低到 0$$$0$$$。如果 The Beast 初始拥有 12$$$12$$$ 点生命值或更多，那么就不可能击败她。
在第二个样例中，如果 The Beast 拥有 10$$$10$$$ 点生命值，英雄可以先使用第二把武器，然后使用第一把武器，将自己的力量值降低到 0$$$0$$$，并将 The Beast 的生命值降低到 0$$$0$$$。
在第三个样例中，英雄获胜的唯一方法是 The Beast 初始拥有 0$$$0$$$ 点生命值。
